title: ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World
abstract: arXiv:2606.19980v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Achieving dexterous robotic manipulation in the real world heavily relies on human supervision and algorithm engineering, which becomes a central bottleneck in the pursuit of general physical intelligence. Although emerging coding agents can generate code to automate algorithm search, their successes remain largely confined in digital environments. We conjecture that the missing abstraction to automate robotics research is a repeatable feedback loop for real-world policy improvement: reset the scene, execute a policy, verify the outcome, and refine the next iteration. To bridge this gap, we introduce ENPIRE, a harness framework for coding agents that instantiates this physical feedback routine with four core modules: an Environment module (EN) for automatic reset and verification, a Policy Improvement module (PI) that launches policy refinement, a Rollout module (R) to evaluate policies with one or multiple physical robots operating

translated_title: ENPIRE：真实世界中智能体机器人策略的自我改进
translated_abstract: 实现真实世界中的灵巧机器人操作严重依赖人工监督和算法工程，这成为追求通用物理智能的核心瓶颈。尽管新兴的编程智能体能够生成代码来自动化算法搜索，但它们的成功大多局限于数字环境中。我们推测，实现机器人研究自动化所缺失的抽象是一个可重复的反馈循环，用于真实世界策略的改进：重置场景、执行策略、验证结果、并改进下一轮迭代。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了ENPIRE，一个面向编程智能体的框架，通过四个核心模块实例化这一物理反馈流程：用于自动重置和验证的环境模块（EN）、启动策略改进的策略改进模块（PI）、用一个或多个物理机器人评估策略的执行模块（R）……
tldr: ENPIRE提出了一个让编程智能体在真实世界中通过“重置-执行-验证-改进”的可重复物理反馈循环实现机器人策略自我改进的框架。
en_tdlr: ENPIRE introduces a harness framework that enables coding agents to self-improve robot policies in the real world through a repeatable physical feedback loop of resetting, executing, verifying, and refining.
